description: Creates a bookmark or updates its title/favicon; resolves the target folder by name and creates it if missing.

fleetId.description: Fleet ID whose bookmark store should be changed.

title.description: Bookmark title to store. Used as the new title when updating an existing bookmark.

faviconUrl.description: Optional favicon URL to store with the bookmark.

folderId.description: Opaque folder ID to place the bookmark under. Omit for the root folder.

purpose.description: Describe why you are saving or refreshing this bookmark, e.g., saving an important page for later
